ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle WXY, with vertex X above, W at the lower left, and Y at the lower right. All three sides have the same pink single tick mark, indicating the three sides are congruent (equal in length). The left side XW is labeled 9x, the right side XY is labeled 4x+5, and the bottom side WY is labeled 6x+3. Reasoning: Because the three sides have the same tick marks, XW = XY = WY.
